CALIFORNIA
DEPARTMENT OF JUSTICE

Rob Bonta
Attorney General

Division of Medi-Cal Fraud & Elder Abuse
P.O. Box 944255
Sacramento, CA 94244-2550
Fax: (916) 263-2565

April 27, 2026

Nicolas_Hernandez

Re: Complaint Declined for Investigation
To Whom It May Concern:

Kifle Gashie Jikamo
DMFEA Reference Number: 303001733

Thank you for submitting a complaint to the Division of Medi-Cal Fraud and Elder Abuse (DMFEA). We have completed our review of the information provided in your complaint. After careful assessment, we have determined the following:

Your complaint has been reviewed and does not meet the criteria for investigation by the DMFEA. While we will take no further action, we appreciate you bringing this matter to our attention.

We value the public’s role in helping us protect vulnerable individuals and safeguard the Medi-Cal program. Thank you again for your concern and commitment to reporting potential fraud or abuse.

If you have additional evidence to further substantiate your complaint, please resubmit the online complaint form on the California Attorney General Website at https://oag.ca.gov/dmfea/reporting or call the complaint line at (800) 722-0432.

Sincerely,

COMPLAINT INTAKE UNIT
Division of Medi-Cal Fraud and Elder Abuse

For ROB BONTA
Attorney General

DMFEA.CIU-0003 rev. 10/15/25
